name: Miami Springs
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Miami Springs, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Miami Springs, FL: Christmas at the Gazebo and Santa parade, a golf cart toy parade, movie night and The Littlest Angel.
lede: Miami Springs celebrates with a Santa parade at the circle, a golf cart parade of toys, a holiday movie night at the aquatic center and a community theater show.
celebrates: The City of Miami Springs builds its season through Parks and Recreation: Christmas at the Gazebo and a Santa parade at Miami Springs Circle, a Holiday Movie Night at the Aquatic Center, 1401 Westward Drive, and a Holiday Golf Cart Parade in which entries bring a new, unwrapped toy. Pelican Playhouse stages The Littlest Angel at the Rebeca Sosa Theater inside the Community Center. The city also owns the Glenn H. Curtiss Mansion and Gardens, a Pueblo Revival home from 1925 that hosts free or reduced admission events open to the public.
lastyear: We could not find a published recap of the city's 2025 holiday events. The city's parks pages describe the Holiday Golf Cart Parade as a toy collection, with golf cart entries bringing one new, unwrapped toy, and describe Christmas at the Gazebo as a wristband event with different resident and non resident pricing. Those pages are the city's own descriptions, not a news report on last year's events.
facts: Aviation pioneer Glenn Curtiss founded Miami Springs, Hialeah and Opa-locka. The Curtiss Mansion at 500 Deer Run was home to Curtiss and his family from its construction in 1925 to his death in 1930. It joined the National Register of Historic Places in 2001 and has belonged to the city since 1998. Volunteers restored it to its 1925 condition after three arsons, raising more than $4.5 million.
trains: Tri-Rail's Miami Airport station is at 3861 NW 21st Street, and passengers headed to MiamiCentral transfer at the Metrorail Transfer Station. Metrorail's Orange Line runs northbound to the Miami International Airport station, and the Green Line runs between Palmetto and Dadeland South. Brightline's MiamiCentral station is at 161 NW 6th Street in Miami. For a bigger train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has its own page on our site.

kidfact: Glenn Curtiss, who built the mansion in Miami Springs, is called the Father of Naval Aviation, and he held several hundred patents.
faq: Where is Christmas at the Gazebo in Miami Springs?

It is held at Miami Springs Circle, also called Curtiss Circle, at Curtiss Parkway and Westward Drive. The city's page says wristbands are required, with separate resident and non resident pricing, and our Miami Springs card lists the 2026 details.
What is the Holiday Golf Cart Parade?
It is a parade of decorated golf carts from the Miami Springs Golf Course parking lot to the Community Center. Spectators watch free, and golf cart entries are asked to bring one new, unwrapped toy.
Is there a free holiday show in Miami Springs?

Pelican Playhouse lists free tickets, first come first served, for The Littlest Angel at the Rebeca Sosa Theater in the Community Center, with donations welcome. Check the playhouse site for the current ticket details.

Curtiss was an aviation pioneer, inventor and developer who founded Miami Springs, Hialeah and Opa-locka. His Pueblo Revival mansion at 500 Deer Run is on the National Register of Historic Places and belongs to the city.
